annotations.title: Salary needed for a target take-home pay

description: Works backwards from the take-home pay someone wants to the gross annual salary they need in Australia, for 2025-26 or 2026-27. Give the target take-home per week, fortnight, month or year; returns the salary needed (excluding super), the take-home and tax withheld for each pay period, and the employer's super on top. Use it for salary negotiations and questions like 'what do I need to earn to take home $1,500 a week'. It uses the same ATO withholding formulas as take_home_pay. AUD. Read-only and deterministic.

foreignResident.description: Foreign resident for tax purposes. Default false.

studyLoan.description: Has a HELP, VSL, SSL or other study and training support loan. Default false.

takeHome.description: Take-home pay wanted, in AUD, for the period in 'per', e.g. 1500.

taxFreeThreshold.description: Tax-free threshold claimed with this employer. Default true (main job). Use false for a second job.

taxYear.description: Australian financial year (1 July to 30 June) whose withholding tables to use. Default 2026-27.
